messages:
sophia (ML Eng): Kicking off first-touch for tessera-13b bring-up. Need a quick priority and smoke plan: throughput/latency (512/2048), int8 vs int4 sweep, and a minimal eval-run for QA gating. Who can own a 48h mini-sweep?

anil (Perf): I can own the microbench sweep. Plan: 1) single-GPU p95 latency at seq512/2048, 2) throughput map batch sizes [1,2,4,8], 3) quant delta int8/int4 token/sec. Will post scripts.

sophia (ML Eng): thanks. Add a tiny quality check: 100 prompts from convo-eval and 50 code-generation samples. Compare logits/strips vs reference to catch hallucinations.

jamie (SRE): Heads up: node pool x-gpu-v2 has maintenance window in ~36h. If you need steady dedicated capacity, request now or lock to reserved slot. Otherwise we'll have preemptible variance.

anil (Perf): noted. I'll start on preemptible nodes then repro on reserved if variance >5%.

omar (Product): prioritize latency at 512 for interactive chat customers, throughput for batch embedding fallback later. If int4 costs degrade quality >1.5% on conv-eval, block rollout.

sophia (ML Eng): quick checklist I'm putting in thread:
- owner: anil (microbench), sophia (eval), jamie (infra)
- bench commands (example)
```
./run_bench --model tessera-13b --ctx 2048 --batch 4 --quant int8 --measure latency,throughput --warmup 30 --steps 200
```
- eval command: `python eval_runner.py --model tessera-13b --prompts conv-100.json --metric rouge,exact_match,rate_halluc`
- smoke quality gate: delta_acceptance <= 1.5% conv-eval accuracy AND no catastrophic bad responses in top 100 samples
- canary plan: 5% traffic hosted -> monitor cost/latency/errors for 2h -> 25% if stable -> full rollout

anil (Perf): running first microbench now on a test shard. Will post raw numbers when done. Quick note: for int4 we need custom kernel; may need a restart of runtime process to pick kernels.

ci-bot: build/bench-runner #842 started by anil — running bench matrix (ctx:512,2048) x (batch:1,2,4,8) x (quant:int8,int4). Logs: https://ci.internal/842

jamie (SRE): if anyone needs >4 concurrent bench jobs, ping me. Also tagging @infra-alerts for potential noisy-neighbor checks.

anil (Perf): initial p95 latency (seq512, batch1, int8): 62ms on a40-equivalent. seq2048, batch1: 240ms. Int4 looks ~1.18x faster but needs validation vs tokenization differences. Posting full CSV in 30m.

sophia (ML Eng): good start. After numbers, I'll run eval_runner and post the quality summary. If int4 fails gate, we fallback to int8 + cache/kv tweaks.

omar (Product): Also logging a customer ask: sub-80ms p95 for short chat (seq<256) is a win metric for roadmap. Keep that in scope.

anil (Perf): noted. Will add seq256 quick probe.

ci-bot: bench-runner #842 finished: summary attached. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/842/artifacts. (raw CSV, flamegraphs, kernel-logs)

sophia (ML Eng): pulled artifacts. Quick quality pass: conv-eval accuracy drop int4 vs int8 = 0.9% (within gate), halluc rate unchanged in top100. Marking preliminary OK but need longer run with diversified prompts.

jamie (SRE): confirmed no infra alerts during bench window. However noticed ephemeral disk I/O spike on one host — flagged and isolated. No retries observed in logs.

anil (Perf): next steps: full 24h sweep on reserved slot to check variability, add latency tailing for seq2048 with large-batch bursts, and run golden prompts (50) for hand inspection. Assigning labels: perf:high, quality:medium.

sophia (ML Eng): thanks team. I'll open a follow-up ticket with the canary window and invite eng-oncall for the rollout. If any regression shows in the longer run, we will lock to int8 and revisit quant knobs. :thumbsup:
